_note: Research demonstrator — not a medical device. Every value here is a PLACEHOLDER chosen only so the simulator runs. None is a clinical value. Changing one is a DECISIONS.md entry.

local_confirm_window_s.note: CONTACT must be confirmed within this time or returns to IDLE

isf_confirm_reads.note: positive ISF reads needed to confirm (a valid lateral-flow positive confirms on its own)

isf_confirm_min_gap_s.note: minimum gap between first and last confirming ISF reads

isf_rise_bands.note: S1: ISF level rise counted as systemic

spo2_fall_per_10min.note: S2 trend: falling at least this fast

rr_rise_per_10min.note: S3 trend: rising at least this fast

hr_enabled.note: S4 heart-rate trend; off by default

standdown_s.note: dry-bite stand-down after this long with no systemic signal; never on an expired sensor

danger_level.note: local level (moderate) that starts the danger timer

danger_time_s.note: strong local signal held this long escalates with BROAD payload class

systemic_only_clear_s.note: SYSTEMIC_ONLY returns to IDLE after systemic signs clear for this long

heartbeat_s.note: HEARTBEAT after this long with nothing sent

retry_interval_s.note: retry interval while an urgent message (ALERT, cancel, resolved) waits; also the first routine retry

retry_backoff_max_s.note: routine messages only: wait doubles after each failure up to this

link_min_signal.note: routine messages only: don't power up a send unless the signal shows this many bars. Never applied to urgent messages

urgent_blind_attempt_s.note: urgent messages while the signal reads 0 bars: a cheap signal check every retry_interval_s, but a full send attempt at least this often anyway (the reading can be wrong)

stuck_alarm_s.note: an urgent message unsent this long sets off the band's local alarm (buzzer + light): move to open sky

queue_max.note: queue limit; oldest routine message dropped first; urgent messages never dropped; only the newest HEARTBEAT kept

lfa_control_min_contrast.note: control line must be at least this much darker than the strip beside it, or the test is INVALID

lfa_band_ratios.note: test-line darkness as a fraction of the control line's: at or above each cut-off = band 1 trace, 2 low, 3 moderate, 4 high. Band 3 starts the R-01 danger timer, so these are dispatch logic

lfa_control_search.note: where inside the result window the control line may be (nominal 0.12); kept narrow so a missing control can never be confused with the 3FTx line at 0.29, nor a flipped image's SVSP line at 0.20

vitals_plausible.note: a reading outside these is treated as a sensor artifact and dropped (not carried forward)

vitals_max_gap_s.note: a 'sustained' SpO2/breathing condition only counts if there is no gap in readings longer than this inside the hold window
